body:
Mistakes happen: a wrong flavor, a typo in the address, a change of mind about the payment method. Many of them can be fixed if you contact us early, and the earlier the better, because an order gets harder to change the further it moves through processing and shipping. This guide explains what can usually be changed and what cannot, how to ask, how cancellations and refunds work, how to switch payment methods without paying twice, how to correct an address, what to do about orders you have already paid for and how to avoid needing changes in the first place. It follows our published [shipping policy](/shipping/) and [refund policy](/refunds/) and is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## What can usually be changed
Before payment is confirmed and the order is processed, we can often update flavors, strengths, pack sizes, quantities and shipping details. If you have not yet paid, changes are simple: we update the order, recalculate the total and send you fresh payment details so you pay the right amount once. If your order has been paid but is not yet processing, changes are still often possible, but we may need to adjust the total, and either collect or return the difference. Once an order is processing, changes get harder, because items may already be picked.

## What cannot be changed
After the package is handed to the carrier, we cannot change the address or the contents. At that point the parcel is in the carrier's hands and we have no control over its route. If the address was wrong, contact us straight away, because we may be able to ask the carrier for help, but we cannot promise a change. For in-transit issues, see [what to do if your package is delayed](/blog/what-to-do-if-your-package-is-delayed/).

## How to ask
Contact us right away with your order ID using the [contact page](/contact/), the support chat, WhatsApp or email. Tell us exactly what to change, for example "change item 2 from 12mg to 9mg" or "update the address to 123 Main St, Apt 4". Include the order ID, the name and email on the order and your phone number. We will reply to confirm. Do not assume a change is made until we confirm it in writing, and do not pay a new amount until we have sent updated details.

## Changing the items
- **Strength or pack size:** tell us the product and the option you want. We update the order and recalculate the price from our catalog.
- **Quantity:** tell us the new quantity. Remember that the minimum order is $100 and that free shipping applies at $200 or more after discount.
- **Adding an item:** possible if the order has not been processed. We will send updated details.
- **Removing an item:** possible before processing, as long as the order stays above the minimum.

If a change moves your order across a threshold, we explain the effect on the total before you pay. See [minimum order and free shipping explained](/blog/minimum-order-and-free-shipping-explained/).

## Cancelling
If payment has not been confirmed yet, we can usually cancel without issue. Tell us the order ID and that you want to cancel, and we confirm. If you paid, refunds follow our [refund policy](/refunds/), which includes a restocking fee in some cases and applies within 30 days of purchase. Cancelling before the order is processed is the simplest case, and we will explain what applies to your order. Refunds go back through the payment method the payment was received through, minus a 15% restocking fee where it applies. See [refund and return policy explained](/blog/refund-and-return-policy-explained/).

## Changing payment method
Switching between methods is simplest before we send payment details or before you pay. Contact us first so you do not pay twice. For example, if you chose Cash App and would rather use crypto to take the 10% discount, tell us before you pay, and we will update the order, recalculate the total and send the right details. If you have already paid by one method, switching is more complicated, and we will advise on the best way. See [payment methods compared](/blog/payment-methods-compared/).

## Fixing an address
Tell us the corrected address in writing and wait for confirmation. Include the full address with the apartment or suite number. Note that delivery needs an adult signature at that address, so make sure someone aged 21 or older can receive it. If the order has shipped, contact us immediately, and we will see whether the carrier can help. If the carrier returns the parcel because the address was wrong or no one could sign, we refund minus the 15% restocking fee and the shipping cost. See [shipping address tips](/blog/shipping-address-tips/).

## Orders you have already paid for
If you paid and want to change or cancel, contact us quickly, because processing starts once payment is confirmed. We will tell you what is possible. If the order is still waiting in the queue, changes are usually easy. If it has been processed, we will explain the options, which may include accepting the order and then using our returns process for eligible items. Opened or used e-liquid, devices and accessories cannot be returned, and Puffco products do not qualify for refunds or exchanges, so check before you buy those.

## Avoiding issues
Most changes are avoidable with a few habits:

- **Double-check your cart** before you submit: options, quantities and totals.
- **Double-check your address,** including the apartment number, and make sure an adult can sign.
- **Review your confirmation email** immediately after ordering, and tell us about mistakes straight away.
- **Choose the payment method you will actually use,** so you do not need to switch.
- **Read** [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/) so you know where your order is.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### How long do I have to change an order?
There is no fixed window, but the earlier the better. Before payment is confirmed is easiest. Once the order is processing, changes get harder, and once the carrier has it, we cannot change it.

### Will changing my order delay it?
Small changes before processing usually do not. Larger changes may add a little time while we update the order and, if needed, new payment details.

### Can I cancel just one item?
Often yes before processing, as long as the order stays above the $100 minimum. After processing, our returns process applies to eligible items.

### What if I paid by crypto and want to cancel?
Contact us right away. Because crypto transfers are final, we explain how a refund is returned, in the coin used, less the 15% restocking fee where it applies.

### What if I do not get a reply?
Customer service hours are Monday to Saturday, 9AM to 7PM Pacific Standard Time. Message again on WhatsApp or by phone, and include your order ID.

## Related reading
See [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/) and [how to contact support](/blog/how-to-contact-support/). Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Examples of changes and how we handle them
### Example 1: wrong strength, not yet paid
You ordered a 12mg bottle and meant 9mg, and you have not paid yet. You contact us with the order ID. We change the option, the price recalculates from the catalog, we send updated payment details if needed and you pay the new amount once.

### Example 2: wrong address, already paid, not yet processed
You notice a typo in your street number after paying. You contact us at once. We correct the address in writing, confirm back to you and mark the order, and it ships to the right place.

### Example 3: change of mind about the payment method
You chose Cash App and now prefer crypto for the discount. You tell us before paying. We switch the method, the total drops by 10% on the product subtotal, and we send the crypto payment window or the details you need.

### Example 4: the parcel has shipped, the address was wrong
You realize the apartment number was missing. You contact us immediately with the tracking number. We contact the carrier to see what is possible. If the carrier cannot help, the parcel may be returned, and a refund minus the 15% restocking fee and shipping cost applies.

### A final reminder
Contact us early, tell us exactly what to change and wait for our written confirmation. A clear message with your order ID, the change you want and your contact details gets the fastest result, and it protects you from paying twice or receiving the wrong items.

### Frequently asked questions in depth
**Do changes affect the 10% discount?** The discount applies to the product subtotal for the payment method you choose, so a change to the items changes the discount too. We show the new total before you pay.

**Can I add a gift card payment after ordering?** Please tell us before you pay and we will switch the method and send the buy and upload links.

**What if I change my mind after the parcel arrives?** Our returns policy applies: contact us within 30 days, and unopened items in original packaging can be returned, less a 15% restocking fee. Opened or used items cannot be returned.

**What if I cannot reach you quickly?** Message us on WhatsApp, use the support chat or call. The sooner we see your message, the more we can do.
